name: deprecated
description: Archive of superseded and retired skills kept installable for old workflows; each skill names its replacement or says it retired

interface.shortDescription: Archive of superseded skills; prefer the replacements
interface.longDescription: Superseded and retired skills moved out of their original plugins, kept installable so old workflows keep resolving. Each skill carries a deprecation banner naming its replacement in the presentations plugin, the writing plugin (ghostwrite, coach) or taste-skill, or saying it retired without replacement, as the whole former workbench plugin did. Do not install alongside presentations or writing unless you need the old skill names.
